brief:
Mohammed Abed, a systems engineer from Gaza, has relocated to Mexico City where he and other Palestinians are establishing themselves through food enterprises. Loud noises continue to trigger anxiety in Abed, a lingering effect of life in Gaza. The community has turned to the culinary sector as a means of economic recovery and cultural expression in their adopted city.

Palestinians displaced from Gaza have found opportunity in Mexico City's food industry, leveraging their heritage and skills to create livelihoods away from conflict. The move reflects broader patterns of Palestinian migration and adaptation in diaspora communities worldwide.
dek: By Diego Oré MEXICO CITY, Oct 2 (Reuters) - Loud noises still cause anxiety for Mohammed Abed, a Palestinian systems engineer from Gaza.
title: Palestinian Gaza refugees rebuild lives through food business in Mexico City
